title: Purim and St. Paddy Free Palestine
author: Susan Block
content:
![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Purim-St-Paddy-
sm.jpg)

The Irish/Jewish [convergence](https://drsusanblock.com/purim-stpatty) of
[Purim](https://drsusanblock.com/tag/Purim) and [St. Patrick’s
Day](https://drsusanblock.com/tag/StPaddy) - with [pro-
bonobo](https://bonoboway.com/) and [Free
Palestine](https://www.counterpunch.org/2024/05/17/reply-to-a-zionist-troll/)
touches - comes together in one lucky [Max
Collage](https://drsusanblock.com/max-collage-purim-stpaddy), as I continue to
try to process my [deep grief](https://drsusanblock.com/bottomless-grief) for
my [beloved husband](https://drsusanblock.com/33rd-wedding-anniversary),
[Maximillian Lobkowicz di Filangieri](https://drsusanblock.com/max-lobkowicz-
filangieri) (11/8/1943 – [May 13, 2025](https://drsusanblock.com/rip-max))
through an auspicious arrangement of sweet-
and-[spicy](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/kink), memory-infused, good-
vibes-triggering holiday photos.

“[Purim & St. Paddy free Palestine](https://drsusanblock.com/max-collage-
purim-stpaddy)” memorializes Captain Max’s fond feelings for his Catholic
childhood and the [Biblical](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/religious-
abuse) holidays of his adopted Judaism, as well as his passionate support for
a [free Palestine](https://www.counterpunch.org/2024/03/22/anti-zionist-purim-
for-palestine/), especially in his [last years](https://drsusanblock.com/go-
bonobos-2025). Together, we created wild, bacchanalian celebrations –
[Squirting St. Paddy’s Eve](https://drsusanblock.com/squirting-st-patty),
[Purim](https://drsusanblock.com/purim-2017)
[Rising](https://drsusanblock.com/purim-rising) and countless [radio
shows](https://drsusanblock.com/show-index) – retelling these ancient tales
through the eyes of [sexologists](https://drsusanblock.com/sexologist-of-the-
year-3).

Regarding the Feasts of [Erin](https://drsusanblock.com/fdr-stormy-st-paddys-
mermaids) and [Esther](https://drsusanblock.com/purim)… at first glance, they
seem as far apart as Ireland is from Iran. But upon deeper reflection, we
realize that [both holidays](https://drsusanblock.com/fdr-lucky-spring-purim)
revolve around luck, lust, lotteries, triangles, copious amounts of alcohol –
green beer or red wine, and whiskey or Schnapps for the deeply observant – and
the erotic, mischievous coming of Spring.

Bottom line: Both Purim and St. Paddy’s are Party Holidays.

**Disarming Charms**

And both Saint Patrick and Queen Esther were the “Life of the Party,”
immigrants in their respective lands of Ireland and Iran who won the day
against all odds with nothing but their Weapons of Mass Seduction.

Before he was a Saint, Patrick was a young British prince. Kidnapped and
enslaved by Irish pirates, he won his freedom, found Jesus, converted pagans,
chased out [snakes](https://drsusanblock.com/rip-snake-eve) and evolved into
the patron saint of the Emerald Isle – and Irish pubs around the world.

Before she was a Queen,
[Esther](https://www.elephantjournal.com/2017/03/purim-the-seductive-
religious-tale-we-never-talk-about/) was a Jewess-in-disguise (real name:
Hadassah). When her cousin – whom Max and I playfully and rather accurately
called “[Pimping Cousin Mordecai](https://drsusanblock.com/purim)” in our
_Commedia Erotica_[Purimshpiels](https://drsusanblock.com/purim) – entered her
into an imperial beauty contest, the “comely” Esther won the heart of the King
of Persia (now Iran) and averted a genocide, thanks to her
[teasing](http://drsusanblockinstitute.com/tease) approach to diplomacy.

You could call Esther’s and Patrick’s talent for winning hearts (and chasing
away snakes) without brute force “charm.” Lucky Charms aren’t just a cereal;
they put the “Sláinte!” in St. Paddy’s Day. And
[seductive](https://drsusanblock.com/dita-von-teese) charm puts the
“[L’Chaim](https://www.counterpunch.org/2025/05/09/lchaim-two-jews-with-
opposing-views/)” ([To Life](https://drsusanblock.com/lchaim-radio)!) in
[Purim](https://drsusanblock.com/purim-2018), the feast of the charming and
divinely disarming Queen
[Esther](https://www.counterpunch.org/2011/03/18/queen-esther-s-weapons-of-
mass-seduction/).

[Captain Max](https://drsusanblock.com/max-lobkowicz-filangieri) was a charmer
too; he certainly charmed me – and I wasn’t the only one. Maybe I charmed him
too. One thing that charmed,
[disturbed](https://www.counterpunch.org/2024/03/07/the-burning-soldier/) and
inspired Max in his last years, even after his
[stroke](https://drsusanblock.com/birthday-healing), was the plight of the
[Palestinian](https://www.counterpunch.org/2021/05/21/shemah-yisrael/) people.
Max was just a nice Jewish Catholic pagan [pro-bonobo](https://bonoboway.com/)
boy who couldn’t abide a genocide.

**St. Paddy’s Pussy Cookies for Palestine**

So, my sixth Max Collage is a kaleidoscope of greens and blues, [Irish
kisses](https://drsusanblock.com/st-patty-sex-evolution) and
[hamantaschen](https://drsusanblock.com/purim-2018#hamantaschen) -- which we
called “[pussy cookies](https://drsusanblock.com/fdr-pussy-cookie-march-
madness),” and which Max loved munching as much as me, preferably with a green
Guineas. So, with St. Paddy’s photos around the edges, Purim in the center and
support for Palestine interspersed throughout, “[Purim & St. Paddy free
Palestine](https://drsusanblock.com/max-collage-purim-stpaddy)” conveys my
dream that the [liberating](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/bonobo-
liberation-therapy) erotic spirits of Purim, St. Patrick’s Day and Captain Max
can somehow [come](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/orgasm) together – like a
Spring miracle – to charm the world and disarm the War Machine, freeing
Palestine and all oppressed peoples.

In these days when a “[Board of
Peace](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/02/23/board-of-peace-machinery-of-
war/)” is just an Orwellian-Machiavellian name for more Zio-Casino [Perma
War](https://drsusanblock.com/domcon-2022#PermaWar), I suppose my collage
conveys a pipedream; as Max often said, “the ideal is the enemy of the real.”
But if St. Paddy and Queen Esther hadn’t pursued their ideals against all the
odds of the real, we wouldn’t have these fun holidays.

May the spunky spirits of Saint Paddy, Queen Esther and Captain Max stop the
wars – on Palestine, Iran, Venezuela, Greenland, Ukraine, Somalia, Canada,
Cuba, Chicago, Minneapolis, LA, and anywhere else I’m forgetting.

May we all live and love in peace (the real thing).
